sentences.l2: 在许多家庭中，家长群已经成为日常存在。
sentences.l1: In many families, the parents' group chat has become a part of daily life.

sentences.l2: 老师通过家长群发布通知、安排作业，并要求家长帮助孩子完成打卡。
sentences.l1: Teachers post notices and assign homework through the parents' group chat, and ask parents to help their children complete check-ins.

sentences.l2: 这样的家校沟通本意是促进合作，却常常加重家长负担。
sentences.l1: This kind of home-school communication was originally meant to promote cooperation, but it often increases the burden on parents.

sentences.l2: 白天上班后，许多父母仍要盯着手机，确认作业是否提交、打卡是否完成，还要拍照、录制视频或撰写反馈。
sentences.l1: After working during the day, many parents still have to keep their eyes on their phones, confirming whether homework has been submitted and whether check-ins have been completed, and also have to take photos, record videos, or write feedback.

sentences.l2: 若稍晚回复，便可能被视为不够配合；若孩子没有按要求完成，老师也会在群里提醒。
sentences.l1: If they reply a little late, they may be seen as not cooperative enough; if the child has not finished as required, the teacher will also remind them in the group.

sentences.l2: 于是，原本属于家庭生活的夜晚，被一条条消息切割成碎片。
sentences.l1: So the evenings that originally belonged to family life are cut into fragments by messages one after another.

sentences.l2: 家长不仅承担监督学习的责任，还要扮演记录者、协调者甚至助教。
sentences.l1: Parents not only bear the responsibility of supervising study, but also have to play the roles of recorder, coordinator, and even teaching assistant.

sentences.l2: 长期如此，亲子之间的耐心被消耗，家长自身的休息与情绪也受到影响。
sentences.l1: After a long time like this, the patience between parents and children is worn down, and the parents' own rest and emotions are also affected.

sentences.l2: 家校沟通需要更清晰的边界，让老师、家长和学生都能在合理范围内参与。
sentences.l1: Home-school communication needs clearer boundaries, so that teachers, parents, and students can all take part within a reasonable range.
